acceptance_predicates.description: Each verifier uses a private workspace and binds Java temporary and working directories to it.
Capacity preflight and runtime storage overages produce durable typed failures, including fast-exit overages.
An over-budget required-mode run explicitly stops its unique transient systemd unit.

definition_of_done: The merged exact vendor and locally reproducible tests demonstrate private workspaces and storage handling.
A bounded formal tier completes within its declared budget without shared temporary-module paths.
No external signature, authentication, hosted approval, or external review is required.

inputs.description: TLC runner, formal verifier, and contained execution resources.

outputs.description: Typed local receipt for normal and resource-exhausted formal execution.

gates.description: Locally reproducible functional evidence is required; external systems are supplementary only.
